tools.name: describe_travel_decoder
tools.description: List single-trip destinations, insurers, feature filters, score floors, and sort orders. Call this before list_travel_plans. Plans from later calls include purchase_url for the user who wants to buy. Comparison data is not a personal recommendation or a policy.

tools.name: list_travel_plans
tools.description: Return at most 5 single-trip travel plans for one destination, trip length, and traveller mix, with scores, cover limits, premium, and purchase_url. There is no next page. Figures are indicative. The product page is the authority for price and cover.

tools.name: get_travel_plan
tools.description: Return one single-trip plan under the same filters as list_travel_plans, including purchase_url. A plan that does not match the filters is not found. Figures are indicative.
